summary: (standards pass) This change makes .cargo/config.toml the one carrier of the msvc `+crt-static` flag, but build-native.yml's pull_request paths do not include `.cargo/**`: a PR that touches only that file (another [target] rustflags table, a profile setting) does not run the Windows row's import check or any binary floor check; pr-guard's safety check catches only a removed crt-static. Fix: add `.cargo/**` to build-native.yml's pull_request paths.
